OverviewProduct GroupsApplications

Solar systems built around dependable water delivery.

Solar pumping is one of the strongest ways to reduce operating cost and increase resilience in remote, agricultural, and distributed water infrastructure projects.

  • Solar pumping for irrigation, livestock, and community water supply.
  • Panel and mounting systems for rooftop, ground, and elevated layouts.
  • Lower power dependency for sites exposed to unstable utility supply.

Solar Product Groups

We combine solar pumping equipment with PV modules and structures that match site terrain, energy demand, and deployment approach.

Solar Water Pumping Systems

High-efficiency solar pumping for irrigation, livestock, and community supply, with AC and DC options.

Solar Panels

Durable photovoltaic panels for residential, commercial, and agricultural duty.

Solar Structures

Corrosion-resistant mounting systems for rooftop, ground, and elevated deployments.

Where Solar Delivers the Most Value

Solar solutions are particularly effective where pumping is essential but grid power is expensive, unstable, or unavailable.

Irrigation

Reliable field water delivery for agriculture without relying on fuel-heavy pumping.

Livestock Watering

Distributed pumping in ranching and pastoral contexts where remote reliability matters.

Community Supply

Shared water schemes with lower operating cost and better resilience.

Institutional Sites

Schools, health facilities, and campuses seeking cleaner energy for pumping needs.
